notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #15
notes.content:
[h1][b]
[/b][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png"][/img][/h1][p]
[/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone! This is the [i]Astra Village[/i] development team. 👩‍🌾✨
Today, we’d like to show you some UI elements that have actually been implemented in the game.[/p][p][/p][quote][p]Please note that the language settings are not yet unified.
Also, as these are under development, the final release may differ from what is shown here. 
Thank you for your understanding.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Item Encyclopedia & Crafting Encyclopedia[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/eb10161eb6d30dea7effacd2733873fb47635649.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added a feature that allows you to jump between the two encyclopedias by clicking on the item icons showing usage or materials.[/p][p][/p][p]This helps players understand recipes more easily and reduces the hassle of switching encyclopedias.
As crafting is an important part of the game, we’ve worked to make this system as user-friendly as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][h3]
✔ Map & Marker[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/a43f10abcf05b70f4eef090e46f6de5f12bd0bbc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]We’ve implemented a marker function on the map.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]By clicking on a location where you want to place a marker, a window will appear.[/p][p]You can write a memo, select a marker icon, and place the marker by pressing the save button.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]There is also a sort function in the bottom-right corner, allowing you to display only specific markers.[/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]✔ Calendar[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576119/c0d9cd4fbe721236fa3e987e4cdce0b5a0da8a3a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The year consists of four seasons, and each week has six days.[/p][p]The calendar displays special events and NPC birthdays.[/p][p]You can also add your own notes to specific days.[/p][p][/p][p]  [/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][h3]✔ Lastly[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Today we’ve shared some UI elements that have already been implemented in the game.[/p][p]We’ll continue to show more completed UI features as they are ready. Please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Also, Astra Village is now live on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Discord[/b]! 
We’d be thrilled if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] us. 
The [b]Demo version is also available[/b], so please give it a try! ❣[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]➡️ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800"]Astra Village Steam Store Link[/url]
➡️ [url="https://discord.gg/XQuZUTCssa"]Astra Village Discord Link[/url][/p]

notes.title: 🎉Demo Version Released!!🎉
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294800/_/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/2e88c55b069814d876dc254eeafd0171ace07ba1.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]✔ Demo Version Released!! 🎊[/h3]
Thank you for waiting!
The demo version of Astra Village is now available!
Have you tried playing it yet?


Here are some convenient features and hidden elements that are not introduced in the game!


[h3]✔ Farming Convenience Feature[/h3]
If you [b]hold the left mouse button without pressing the movement keys[/b], the character will automatically move forward and use tools.
They’ll till the soil, plant seeds, and water the crops—
just like in the video below!

[previewyoutube=hmvFgC-UYMM;full][/previewyoutube]



[h3]✔ Hidden Altar[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/9ed179f6e3dfdefb63fb3648638c8ecd633c818e.png[/img]
There’s a hidden path that leads to an altar.
Inside the treasure chest, you’ll find a [u]powerful golden-glowing bow[/u]. Try to find it!




[h3]✔ Hidden Boss[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/3d43c2e463c951038afae0199ff12085d92e283f.png[/img]
Rumor has it that a turtle is holding a [u]watering can that endlessly pours water[/u].
It will be super useful for farming! But... where is the turtle?






If you’ve played the demo, please share tips and info in the comments!
We’ve also opened our SNS and Discord community—feel free to join us! (⋈◍＞◡＜◍)♡

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/eaf15b69dcf85bf184223b2be45fedccac420c4f.png[/img]


[h3]✔ The demo version has been uploaded to Steam![/h3]


Hello! We’re the development team of “Astra Village.” 👩‍🌾✨
The demo version is now complete, incorporating the feedback and improvements we received at PlayX4.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/123c961e06373053d72efa5b11b6e008f77dab8e.png[/img]



The demo page has passed the review process, and the demo build is now awaiting final approval.
It usually takes about 3–5 business days, so we expect it to be ready within a week.

We’ll post another announcement once the demo is officially published!







[h3]✔ Localized Title[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/b665d08babfb92bd53159f0fee647f26b1d582c8.png[/img]

The issue where the game could only be searched in English has been resolved.
We submitted a request to Steam to localize the game title in English, Korean, and Japanese—and it was approved!







[h3]✔ Store Page Update[/h3]

We have updated the store page to better showcase what Astra Village is about using video content.
Now it provides a more intuitive understanding of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/538572c0adfcd19b9e3a846cf64c366e3a259801.png[/img]

You can check the updated content directly on the Steam page.
If you'd like to see the new video-based information, check the Steam store link below!






[h3]✔ Get Notified by Following & Wishlisting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/b665d08babfb92bd53159f0fee647f26b1d582c8.png[/img]

If you add Astra Village to your wishlist and follow the store page,
you’ll get notified as soon as the demo becomes available! (⋈◍＞◡＜◍)♡

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #3
notes.content:
[h3]✔ We participated in PlayX4[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/d82aabd1b25fc3d10beb17e34a50dd2d352a1b6c.png[/img]

Thank you once again for checking out our game.
We took part in the game exhibition "PlayX4," which was held over four days from May 22 to 25.
The event reportedly drew around 115,000 visitors.

At the venue, we had gamers actually try the game and gathered valuable feedback.
The demo version to be uploaded on Steam will likely be an improved version based on that feedback.



[h3]✔ Controls Guide[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/a6bb6013bc89a5bfae02e7ad2942acfba9ea024d.png[/img]
One of the most common issues we observed was the lack of clear instructions on how to play.
Although various features were available, many players were unaware of them and experienced inconvenience.
Improving this is essential.





[h3]✔ Improved Guidance[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/fb70c9ecff002ea05b2c58d54ba92a0a0cd2166e.png[/img]
After the tutorial, many players didn’t know where to go next.
Originally, we intended for players to talk to an NPC to progress the quest, but the NPC didn’t stand out enough.
Even when nearby, players often passed by without speaking to them.
We think it would be good to add more events to help guide progress.





[h3]✔ More Reward Variety[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/61047f5855c492ff56329eeceb203a4a04fce30f.png[/img]
Since the current ending involves defeating a boss, players tended to focus heavily on recovery items.
In the upcoming improvements, we plan to diversify rewards by adding weapons and farming-related items.





We believe that after making these three major improvements, the demo will be ready for release.
Once the schedule is decided, we’ll announce it on the Steam community and on X (formerly Twitter).

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #2
notes.content:
Thank you for checking us out!
Hello! We are the development team of “Astra Village”. 👩‍🌾✨

This time, we’d like to introduce the demo version that will be uploaded to Steam.
It’s a condensed version of the main game, with a different storyline for demo purposes.



[h3]✔ Start at the Camp[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/9486f44a2c0cc99eee9847d058ed0c93d12da9d0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/bedc6536caced455196078b82741589d904b0e89.png[/img]

The starting area includes essential elements like fields, a cooking pot, an anvil for crafting, and even NPCs.
Depending on your progress, you'll unlock and build additional facilities.



[h3]✔ A Rare Monster Appears[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/2e220ea95eb351f220c08a4958967e11ec45a740.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/6ae7d7d6e3858a2a73cc52eb1b7e4ddc8505ac68.gif[/img]

A rare monster appears — only one exists on the map!
It may look cute, but it runs away from the player at a surprising speed.



[h3]✔ Cherry Blossom Tree Updated[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/8dd1ed1d5afeae47ed0d4781af0c92d5416214c1.png[/img]

The previous cherry blossom tree has been replaced with a new one.

notes.title: 🎮「Astra Village」Development News #1
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for checking this out. [/h2]
Hello! We are the development team of "Astra Village". 👩‍🌾✨

[h1]✔ More Crops Added [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/df56603d4d942d5cddfe0f6b5bd3df0083a361b8.png[/img]

We’ve increased the variety of crops!  
Along with that, the number of available dishes has more than doubled.  
Collect recipes and try cooking – it might be fun!

[h1]✔ Purchase Window Updated [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/040aa2992c6bcce1dec2cb2ac9bb6f9104a3a880.png[/img]

Not only has the design changed,  
you can now place any item for sale wherever you want using a flexible layout system.  
This should make the purchase screen easier to read… probably.

[h1]✔ New Monster Added [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/537055deec9a59af544453a3db7ba0c7f673898f.png[/img]

A new squishy green monster has joined the game.  
It’s currently the weakest one.  
Still, pretty cute, right?

[h1]✔ A Carrot Got Stuck [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576119/fc12944ce032117a461df29bc77c49e60912aa2d.png[/img]

What is this lonely silhouette...?  
Stay tuned!
